summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting transactions under a share repurchase program initiated December 15, 2025. For the period May 25-June 26, 2026, the company repurchased shares on multiple venues including XMAD, CEUX, and US trading platforms at weighted average prices around €58-€60 per share, totaling 5,072,474 shares for €295.2 million since program inception. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The program is a buyback returning capital to shareholders. Watch for cumulative repurchase progress relative to announced authorization and any impact on share count and EPS.
